elements.name: locale
elements.description: The locale to use for formatting the date. Defaults to en-US.

elements.name: displayFormat
elements.description: The format to use for displaying the date. Defaults to dd/mm/yyyy.

elements.name: tooltipFormat
elements.description: The format to use for displaying the tooltip. Defaults to {weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric"}.

elements.name: timeZone
elements.description: The time zone to use for formatting the date. Defaults to the user's local time zone.

elements.name: fallback
elements.description: The fallback content to display if the date is invalid.

accessibility.general: No accessibility is needed for this component.
